pois.label: ΔE–E 主望远镜
pois.detail: 塔顶壳体开了四分之一剖切,里面是真尺寸的探测叠层:三片 300 µm 硅(A/B/C,Ø3 cm,间距 2 cm)测粒子穿过时丢下的能量 ΔE,下面 3 cm 碘化铯(D)和 2 cm 塑料闪烁体(E)把停下来的粒子的剩余能量 E 全部吃掉,外面一层反符合壳(F)标出漏出去的。ΔE 乘 E 正比于质量乘电荷平方,所以质子、氘、氚、氦 3、氦 4 在 ΔE–E 图上各走一条线。A 和 C 的内圈分段把入射角钉在 20° 以内,这是分同位素的前提。架构借自 MSL RAD,尺寸放大了一倍多以换统计。所有数字是设计仿真在合成测试场上的结果,没有任何火星数据。
pois.detail_en: The shell on the tower top is cut open by a quarter. Inside is the stack at true size: three 300 um silicon detectors (A/B/C, 3 cm across, 2 cm apart) record the energy a particle loses on the way through, dE. Below them 3 cm of caesium iodide (D) and 2 cm of plastic scintillator (E) absorb the remaining energy E of a particle that stops, and an anticoincidence shell (F) flags anything that leaks out. dE times E scales with mass times charge squared, so protons, deuterons, tritons, helium-3 and helium-4 each follow their own line on the dE-E plot. Inner segments on A and C pin the incidence angle within 20 degrees, which is what makes isotopes separable. The architecture is borrowed from MSL RAD and scaled up for statistics. Every number here is a design simulation on a synthetic test field, not Mars data.

physics: Bethe 能损正比于 z²/β²,剩余能量 E 正比于 A·β²,两者相乘就是 A·z²——ΔE–E 图上的一条条香蕉线就是质量数乘电荷平方的等值线。
斜着穿过的粒子在薄层里走的路是 t/cosθ,丢的能量也跟着多,于是轻同位素斜着来和重同位素正着来长得一样。内圈分段把 cosθ 限在 0.937 以上,路径不确定度 7%,小于相邻同位素 33–50% 的质量台阶,这就是分得开的原因。
physics_en: Bethe energy loss scales as z^2/beta^2 and the residual energy as A*beta^2, so their product is A*z^2: each banana line on the dE-E plot is a contour of mass number times charge squared.

A slanted track crosses a thin layer along t/cos(theta) and loses more energy, so a light isotope arriving at an angle looks like a heavier one at normal incidence. The inner segments hold cos(theta) above 0.937, a 7% path uncertainty, smaller than the 33-50% mass step between neighbouring isotopes. That is why they separate.

pois.label: 低能段望远镜
pois.detail: 主壳侧面的细筒是专为 sci-rad-01 留下的那个问题做的:一层 300 µm 的硅里,几 MeV 的停止质子和靶碎片反冲是分不开的。这里第一层只有 20 µm 厚(T0),1 MeV 以上的质子能穿过去进入下面的 300 µm(T1)和 1500 µm(T2),重的反冲碎片只走几微米,永远停在 T0 里。仿真表明这个设计分质子够用,分同位素不够,而且 T0 单层事件里几乎全是大角度进来的轻离子,不是反冲。平台下方那根黄色小筒是朝地的备份,还只是设计修订项。
pois.detail_en: The slim tube on the side of the main shell answers the question sci-rad-01 left open: in one 300 um silicon layer a stopping proton of a few MeV and a target-fragment recoil cannot be told apart. Here the first layer is only 20 um thick (T0). Protons above 1 MeV cross it into 300 um (T1) and 1500 um (T2) layers, while heavy recoil fragments travel a few microns and always stop inside T0. The simulation shows this design separates protons well enough but not isotopes, and that T0-only events are almost all light ions arriving at wide angles, not recoils. The small yellow tube under the platform is a downward-looking copy and is still only a design revision.

The mechanism holds but the purity expectation was wrong: in the T0-only 0.3-6 MeV class fragments are only 1.1%, the rest are light ions arriving at wide angles and leaving through the side. The registered sigma ratio 1.6-2.2 (square root of the geometric factors) missed, measured 0.78: the statistical error of the measured family <Q> is set by the spread of the parts' Q, not only by the event count.
physics: 20 µm 硅刚好是 1 MeV 质子的射程,而一个几 MeV 的硅反冲核射程只有几微米:厚度就是判别器——穿得过的不是反冲。
判别器没说谁会进来:视场越宽,从侧面斜穿 T0 又漏出去的轻离子越多,它们在 T0 里丢的能量和反冲一样多。收窄视场要拿几何因子换。
physics_en: 20 um of silicon is the range of a 1 MeV proton, while a silicon recoil nucleus of a few MeV travels a few microns: the thickness is the discriminator, and whatever gets through is not a recoil.

The discriminator says nothing about what comes in. The wider the view, the more light ions cross T0 at a slant and leave through its side, depositing as much energy in T0 as a recoil would. Narrowing the view costs geometric factor.

pois.label: 读出链电子箱
pois.detail: 箱子里是每路探测器的前端:电荷灵敏放大器、2 微秒成形、再分成 ×1 和 ×32 两档增益送进 14 位模数转换器。它按脉冲幅度记电荷,不按过阈时间记。sci-rad-01 在它的账 19 里量出自己的 Timepix4 前端在 1 万个电子以下根本不认电荷、50 万个电子处钳位;这条链就是为了绕开那两个坑。行为级仿真表明,从阈值到 1.35 亿个电子当量没有钳位,铁核在 300 µm 硅里的 86 MeV 读回误差 0.03%。
pois.detail_en: The box holds one front end per detector: a charge-sensitive amplifier, 2 microsecond shaping, then two gains (x1 and x32) into a 14-bit converter. It records charge as pulse amplitude, not as time over threshold. sci-rad-01 measured in its ledger 19 that its Timepix4 front end does not see charge at all below 10 thousand electrons and clamps near 500 thousand; this chain exists to avoid both. The behavioural simulation shows no clamp from threshold up to the equivalent of 37 million electrons, and an iron nucleus depositing 86 MeV in 300 um of silicon reads back within 0.03%.

physics: 电荷灵敏放大器的输出幅度等于 Q/C_f:幅度对电荷线性是电容定律给的,不靠任何复位逻辑。量程上限是放大器电源轨,不是时间窗——所以两档增益就能盖住从一个最小电离粒子到一个铁核的 1 万倍动态范围。
过阈时间编码的毛病在于:小电荷的脉冲宽度由复位电路定,不由电荷定;大电荷的宽度被计数窗截断。两头都丢信息,而剂量当量恰恰取决于两头。
physics_en: A charge-sensitive amplifier's output amplitude is Q/C_f: linearity in charge comes from the capacitor law, not from any reset logic. The upper limit is the amplifier's supply rail, not a time window, so two gains cover the ten-thousand-fold range from a minimum-ionizing particle to an iron nucleus.

Time-over-threshold encoding loses at both ends: for small charges the pulse width is set by the reset circuit, not by the charge, and for large charges it is cut off by the counting window. Dose equivalent depends on exactly those two ends.

pois.label: LET 谱产品面板
pois.detail: 左边这块屏是本站的第一产品:硅中线能量转移 φ(LET_Si),24 个对数箱,0.1–1000 keV/µm。柱形只是产品形状的示意,本站没有一条实测谱。每个事件的 LET 由 B 层沉积除以径长得到,径长来自 A·C 符合的角度:停止粒子用 ΔE–E 拟合出的角度,穿透粒子用内圈 A1·C1 的平均路径加三层中值。屏上蓝柱是最小电离峰和幂律下落,橙柱是铁组。旁边的 sci-rad-01 单层相机在 1 keV/µm 处直接读高 46%,因为一层硅不知道径长;这里同一处读低 1%。
pois.detail_en: The left screen is this station's first product: the linear energy transfer spectrum in silicon, 24 logarithmic bins from 0.1 to 1000 keV/um. The bars only sketch the product's shape; the station has no measured spectrum. Each event's LET is the B-layer deposit over the path length, and the path comes from the A.C coincidence: a fitted angle for stoppers, the mean inner-cone path and the median of three layers for penetrators. Blue bars are the minimum-ionizing peak and the power-law fall, orange the iron group. The single-layer camera next door, sci-rad-01, reads 46% high at 1 keV/um because one silicon layer does not know the path; here the same point reads 1% low.

physics: LET 是每单位径长的能量,径长是望远镜给的,不是层给的:一层硅只知道沉积了多少,不知道走了多远,于是斜穿的最小电离粒子被读成高 LET。A·C 符合把入射角钉在 37° 以内,内圈钉在 20° 以内,径长的不确定度从无界变成 7%。
在锥内、经种类判别的产品事件只有 0.14 个每秒,因为大多数停在 D 里的粒子先从 4 cm 的碘化铯侧面漏出去了。所以谱是慢产品,而剂量要从 B 层单击取:那里每秒 11 次击中。
physics_en: LET is energy per unit path, and the path is what the telescope supplies, not the layer: a single silicon layer knows how much was deposited, not how far the particle travelled, so a minimum-ionizing particle crossing at a slant reads as high LET. The A.C coincidence pins the incidence angle within 37 degrees and the inner segments within 20, taking the path uncertainty from unbounded to 7%.

The identified, in-cone product events come at only 0.14 per second, because most particles that would stop in D leave the 4 cm caesium iodide through its side first. The spectrum is therefore a slow product, and dose has to come from B-layer singles, where there are 11 hits per second.

pois.detail: 右上这块三色牌回答玻璃厂的问题:质子族(p/d/t 含靶碎片反冲)的 ⟨Q⟩ 是多少。本站把族拆成三块——蓝:主望远镜和低能段望远镜逐个判出的停止 p/d/t,量得出;绿:穿透的 Z=1,Q 恒为 1,量得出;橙:反冲和 1.5 MeV 以下的质子,没有一个硅事件能判它的种类,只能给界。仿真的答案是一个区间而不是一个数,而且区间宽到装得下玻璃厂的 1.44 和它自设带的 2.0:区间的宽度来自反冲的截面与碎片沉积,不来自统计。sci-rad-01 说一层硅分不出族;本站补一句,叠层能量族的大头,但量不到族的品质因子所依赖的那一小块。
pois.detail_en: The three-colour plaque at the upper right answers the glass works' question: what is <Q> of the proton family (p/d/t including target-fragment recoils). This station splits the family in three. Blue: stopping p/d/t identified one by one in the main and low-energy telescopes, measured. Green: penetrating Z=1 with Q fixed at 1, measured. Orange: recoils and protons below 1.5 MeV, whose species no silicon event can name, bounded only. The simulated answer is an interval, not a number, and the interval is wide enough to hold both the glass works' 1.44 and the 2.0 of its own band: its width comes from the recoil cross-section and fragment deposits, not from statistics. sci-rad-01 said one silicon layer cannot separate the family; this station adds that a stack measures the bulk of the family and still cannot measure the small piece the family's quality factor depends on.

physics: ⟨Q⟩_p = 1 + f_hi(Q_hi − 1):族的品质因子全由高 LET 那一小块的剂量份额决定。那一块是反冲和几 MeV 以下的质子,恰好是望远镜判不出种类的那一块;望远镜能把 f_hi 以外的 90% 剂量量准,却对 ⟨Q⟩ 帮不上多少。
反冲是在探测器材料里产生的:硅望远镜里的反冲是硅核碎片,组织里的是碳氧碎片。所以「组织里的族 ⟨Q⟩」在原则上就不是硅仪器能直接量的量,它要靠输运计算,仪器只能给它一个界。
physics_en: <Q>_p = 1 + f_hi(Q_hi - 1): the family's quality factor is decided entirely by the dose share of the small high-LET piece. That piece is recoils and protons below a few MeV, exactly the piece whose species a telescope cannot name; the telescope measures the other 90% of the family dose accurately and it helps <Q> little.

Recoils are made in the detector material: in a silicon telescope they are silicon fragments, in tissue carbon and oxygen fragments. So the family <Q> in tissue is in principle not a quantity a silicon instrument measures directly; it needs a transport calculation, and the instrument can only bound it.

pois.label: 叠层 10 倍剖切教具
pois.detail: 塔顶的真叠层只有 6 厘米高,站在地上看不见,所以旁边立了一个放大十倍的剖切模型。三片黑色的是 300 µm 硅,奶白的是碘化铯,蓝色的是塑料闪烁体,灰色外壳是反符合。橙色细棒是一个在碘化铯里停下来的质子,红色粗棒是一个把整个叠层都穿透的高能铁核。
pois.detail_en: The real stack on the tower is only 6 cm tall and cannot be seen from the ground, so a ten-times cutaway stands beside it. The three black disks are 300 um silicon, the cream block is caesium iodide, the blue one is plastic scintillator and the grey shell is the anticoincidence. The thin orange rod is a proton that stops in the caesium iodide; the thick red rod is an energetic iron nucleus that crosses the whole stack.

specs.为什么硅是 300 µm: 最小电离粒子在 300 µm 里最概然沉积 79 keV,是 10 keV 阈值的 8 倍
specs.为什么 D 用碘化铯: 100 MeV 质子射程 31.7 mm,塑闪要 75.1 mm
specs.穿透类的质子/氦判别: 平衡正确率 0.994;r4:0.30–0.60 MeV 的重叠带改用 (D, E) 两层沉积判,修订类氦份额 0.000(账 14)
specs.闪烁体猝灭(r6,灵敏度): 算法不知情时 ⁴He 正确率 0.98 → 0.65 / 0.29、穿透 Z=1 类进氦 3–6%;p/d/t 不动。光输出律必须写进 ΔE–E 模型并用氦束与重离子束标定;写进去后回到基线。kB 取值:塑闪为转述的常用值、未核原文,碘化铯为无锚的声明带

specs_en.Why 300 um silicon: most probable deposit of a minimum-ionizing particle 79 keV, eight times the 10 keV threshold
specs_en.Why CsI for D: 100 MeV proton range 31.7 mm; plastic would need 75.1 mm
specs_en.Proton/helium split for penetrating trac: balanced accuracy 0.994; r4: the 0.30-0.60 MeV overlap band is decided on the (D, E) deposits, helium share of the revised class 0.000 (ledger 14)
specs_en.Scintillator quenching (r6, a sensitivit: with an algorithm that ignores it, He4 identification 0.98 -> 0.65 / 0.29 and 3-6% helium enters the penetrating Z=1 class; p/d/t do not move. The light-output law has to be in the dE-E model and calibrated with helium and heavy-ion beams; with it in, everything returns to the baseline. kB values: relayed common value for the plastic (source not checked), an unanchored declared band for the CsI

【r4 2026-09-17】叠层的一个盲点(账 13):高于出射能的氦有一部分在 3 cm 碘化铯里发生核作用并停在 D 里(锥内入射的氦标定束里占 2.6%);它在三片硅里的 ΔE 与 40–110 MeV/n 的停止质子相同,于是被 ΔE–E 拟合读成停止的 p/d/t,占 Z=1 停止类强度的 11–15%。内圈分段解不了它(机理不是角度)。修法是用穿透 Z≥2 类做旁带扣除;本册核作用模型不出次级,真实仪器里反符合会否决其中一部分,多少没有测量。

【r6 2026-09-19】账 21(sim/21_quenching.py → out/21_quenching.json):到 r5 为止碘化铯与塑闪都是「线性 + 常数分辨率」。r6 加 Birks 型猝灭(光输出 = ∫dE/(1+kB·S),用本册阻止表沿径迹积分)与 −5% 的光收集不均匀,只做灵敏度:塑闪 kB 0.0126 g·cm⁻²·MeV⁻¹ 是转述的常用值、本册未核原文,碘化铯 0 / 0.0015 / 0.003 是没有锚的声明带。预注册的物理判断:同一速度下 p/d/t 的 S(E) 相同、能量按质量成比例,所以氢同位素判别不受影响——命中(变化 ≤0.02);我接着写的「氦线下移但 ³He/⁴He 的 33% 台阶不动」——错,⁴He 被读成 ³He(0.98 → 0.65 / 0.29):6% 的光输出亏损加上内圈 7% 的角度余地,够跨过半个台阶(这句是我的解释,没有单独验证)。穿透 Z=1 类的 (D,E) 判据放进 3–6% 的氦。必须红支(碘化铯 kB 0.02)⁴He 正确率 0.002,红;旋钮到达数字的闸用一条不共用代码的直接积分核对(氦/质子光输出比 0.9381 对 0.9384)。数据后路径:把光输出律写进判别与 (D,E) 假设——精确知情时回到基线(自证,不计),真值在上角而算法信中心时 ⁴He 0.84、氦份额 0.002。未修的一处:两种闪烁体都猝灭时,停在 E 层的氦闯入者落进响应表近出射能的边缘箱(响应小、权重大),主望远镜类扣氦后的剂量比 1.06 → 1.16;该给响应表加一道基准体积切割,本轮没做。
sim_en: [r1 2026-09-13] Shared stopping module (sim/stopping.py self-test): Landau most probable deposit of a minimum-ionizing particle in 300 um silicon 79 keV (reference 84, -6%), most probable over mean 0.80; restricted mean and deposited mean agree to 1.3%; 100 MeV proton range 31.66 mm in CsI, 75.1 mm in plastic.

[r1 2026-09-13] The first straggling model used a Moyal approximation and ran 9% low in the mean; the second clipped hard at delta-ray escape, piled events into one bin and read a most probable value of 228 keV. Both are retracted; the current model is a numeric Landau distribution with smooth escape.
[r1 2026-09-13] Penetrating tracks split by charge (ledger 01): with a 0.34 MeV per 300 um threshold, protons called helium 0.5% and helium called protons 0.6%; pre-registered <=5%, hit.

[r4 2026-09-17] A blind spot of the stack (ledger 13): part of the helium above the exit energy interacts in the 3 cm of CsI and ends in D (2.6% of a helium calibration beam incident in the cone); its dE in the three silicon layers equals that of a 40-110 MeV/n stopping proton, so the dE-E fit reads it as a stopping p/d/t - 11-15% of the Z=1 stopper class intensity. The inner segments do not help (the mechanism is not angle). The repair is a sideband subtraction from the penetrating Z>=2 class; this dossier's interaction model emits no secondaries, a real anticoincidence would veto part of these, by how much is not measured.

[r6 2026-09-19] Ledger 21 (sim/21_quenching.py -> out/21_quenching.json): until r5 the CsI and the plastic were 'linear + constant resolution'. r6 adds Birks-type quenching (light = integral dE/(1+kB S) along the track from this dossier's stopping tables) and a -5% light-collection non-uniformity, as a sensitivity only: kB 0.0126 g cm-2 MeV-1 for the plastic is a relayed common value whose source this dossier has not checked, 0 / 0.0015 / 0.003 for the CsI is an unanchored declared band. The registered physical judgement - at equal velocity p/d/t share S(E) and their energies scale with mass, so hydrogen isotope identification is unaffected - hit (change <= 0.02); the next sentence, 'the helium lines move down but the 33% He3/He4 step does not', was wrong: He4 is read as He3 (0.98 -> 0.65 / 0.29), a 6% light deficit plus the 7% angular freedom of the inner segments is enough to cross half the step (my explanation, not separately verified). The (D, E) rule lets 3-6% helium into the penetrating Z=1 class. The must-red branch (CsI kB 0.02) gives He4 0.002, red; the knob gate checks the helium/proton light ratio against a direct integration sharing no code (0.9381 vs 0.9384). Path declared after data: the light-output law inside the identification and the (D, E) hypotheses - back to the baseline when informed exactly (a self-proof, not counted), He4 0.84 and helium share 0.002 when the truth sits at the upper corner while the algorithm believes the centre. One thing not repaired: with both scintillators quenching, helium intruders stopping in E land in the response table's edge bins near the exit energy (small response, large weight) and the helium-corrected main class ratio goes 1.06 -> 1.16; the response needs a fiducial cut, not done this round.
physics: 薄硅里的能损是 Landau 分布:大多数穿越丢得比平均少,少数撞出高能 δ 电子丢得多。所以最概然值只有均值的八成,而三层取中值能压掉单层里偶然的一大发。
碘化铯密度 4.51 g/cm³,原子序数高,单位长度的阻止本领是塑料的两倍多:要在几厘米内停住 100 MeV 质子,只能用它。
physics_en: Energy loss in thin silicon follows a Landau distribution: most crossings lose less than the mean and a few knock out an energetic delta electron and lose much more. The most probable value is therefore only about eight tenths of the mean, and taking the median of three layers suppresses a chance large hit in one of them.
Caesium iodide has a density of 4.51 g/cm3 and a high atomic number, with more than twice the stopping power of plastic per unit length: stopping a 100 MeV proton within a few centimetres takes it.

pois.label: 标定柜
pois.detail: 黄柜子代表这台仪器离不开的标定。读出链的增益常数由脉冲发生器定,碘化铯的弹道亏损是一个恒定的扣除项。判断一个事件是干净停止还是在碘化铯里撞碎了,靠拟合优度的切割值,这个值只能从没有核反应的标定数据里定。仿真里这些常数都能算出来,真仪器上每一个都要先量。
pois.detail_en: The yellow cabinet stands for the calibrations this instrument cannot do without. The chain's gain constants come from a pulser, and the caesium iodide ballistic deficit is a constant to subtract. Whether an event is a clean stop or broke up inside the caesium iodide is decided by a cut on the fit quality, and that cut can only be set from calibration data without nuclear interactions. In the simulation every one of these constants can be computed; on a real instrument each one has to be measured first.

【r1 2026-09-13】种类分离账(账 01):厚度表 +5%、增益 +3%、噪声 ×1.5 同时注入时内圈矩阵不变;三倍注入时 d 0.918、t 0.905、⁴He 0.921。标定精度要求因此落在「厚度与增益都在 ±5% 内」这一档,不是更紧。

【r5 2026-09-18】账 20(sim/20_inflight_cal.py → out/20_inflight_cal.json):这块牌子第一次有了自己的账——不加硬件,用场自己的粒子标定。硅各层增益:取三层沉积中位数之比(比值消掉未知入射角);预注册用内圈穿透 Z=1 类,每 sol 6.8 千个事件,2% 漂移一个 sol 里只有 3.0σ——无功效(闸红,按名排除);改用任何三层都有信号的 A·C 符合(数据后声明),每 sol 10.9 万个事件、0.16%/sol、2% 漂移 12.5σ,注入 +2% 回收 +2.00%。碘化铯能标:内圈停在 D 的质子,由硅沉积反推入射能、预测 E_D,估计量自身偏 −1.1%,0.7 个 sol 到 1%,注入 +3% 回收 +2.96%。产品能容忍多大:D 增益 +2…+3% 就让扣氦后的主望远镜类剂量比移 +0.05(负向只移 −0.02…−0.03,不对称),所以卡上 r1 写的「±5% 这一档」对碘化铯要收紧到约 ±2%;修订 Z=1 类的氦份额在 D/E ±5% 下仍是 0.000。没算的:脉冲发生器线性(账 05)、闪烁体猝灭与光收集不均匀(本册 D/E 响应是线性的)。

【r7 2026-09-19】账 26(sim/26_task_sim_r7.py → out/26_task_r7.json):把失配注入搬到 r4–r6 的新链上(标定表全部保持标称,只有场样本的读出与重建用的厚度表带失配)。增益是六个产品共同的主导失配:+3% 让主望远镜类扣氦后的比值 +0.07(预注册 ≤0.05,偏出)、φ(>1) +6%(命中);厚度表 +5% 让 φ(>1) −3.6%(预注册 ≤3%,偏出);噪声 ×1.5 几乎无作用;×3 注入四个产品越过 3σ(闸能红)。双关对照首跑红:两个标称种子的穿透类比值差 0.060——六个种子的相对标准差 2.5%,0.05 的带对两格之差只是 1.5σ,这道闸是在不知道散布多大时写的(按名排除,改用六种子)。连带后果:r4–r6 引用的单种子类比值都带 ±2.5%;六种子均值是主望远镜类 1.01、穿透 Z=1 类 0.96、φ(>1) 0.95。
sim_en: [r1 2026-09-13] Front-end ledger (ledger 05, out/05_afe.json): the 100 us CSA feedback time constant under a 4 us peaking time makes the whole chain read 2.3% low, constant per channel; pulser calibration at 1 MeV (silicon), 100 MeV (CsI) and 50 MeV (plastic) gives constants 0.977/0.977/0.976. The first version applied the gain constant before the ballistic-deficit constant, corrected CsI twice and read 7.1% high; the order was fixed.

[r1 2026-09-13] Species ledger (ledger 01): thickness table +5%, gain +3% and noise x1.5 injected together leave the inner-segment matrix unchanged; at three times that, d 0.918, t 0.905, 4He 0.921. The calibration requirement therefore sits at thickness and gain within +-5%, no tighter.

[r5 2026-09-18] Ledger 20 (sim/20_inflight_cal.py -> out/20_inflight_cal.json): the first ledger behind this plaque - calibration from the field's own particles, no added hardware. Silicon gain per layer: the ratio of the three layer medians (the ratio cancels the unknown angle); the registered class (inner penetrating Z=1, 6.8k events/sol) sees a 2% drift at only 3.0 sigma in one sol - no power (gate red, excluded by name); any A.C coincidence with three silicon hits (declared after data) gives 109k events/sol, 0.16%/sol, 12.5 sigma, +2% injected recovered as +2.00%. CsI scale: inner protons stopping in D, incident energy from the silicon deposits, predicted E_D; estimator bias -1.1%, 1% in 0.7 sol, +3% recovered as +2.96%. Tolerance: a D gain error of +2..+3% already moves the helium-corrected main class ratio by +0.05 (negative errors only -0.02..-0.03, asymmetric), so the r1 statement 'within +-5%' tightens to about +-2% for the CsI; the helium share of the revised Z=1 class stays 0.000 under D/E +-5%. Not computed: pulser linearity (ledger 05), scintillator quenching and light-collection non-uniformity (D/E are linear here).

[r7 2026-09-19] Ledger 26 (sim/26_task_sim_r7.py -> out/26_task_r7.json): mismatch injection moved onto the r4-r6 chain (all calibration tables nominal; only the readout of the field sample and the thickness table used by the reconstruction are off). Gain is the dominant mismatch for all six products: +3% moves the helium-corrected main class ratio by +0.07 (registered <= 0.05, miss) and phi(>1) by +6% (hit); thickness table +5% moves phi(>1) by -3.6% (registered <= 3%, miss); noise x1.5 does almost nothing; at x3 four products cross 3 sigma (the gate can fire). The both-off control went red on the first run: the two nominal seeds differ by 0.060 in the penetrating class ratio - six seeds give a relative sd of 2.5%, so a 0.05 band is 1.5 sigma of a two-cell difference; the gate was written blind to the scatter it polices (excluded by name, six seeds now). Consequence: single-seed class ratios quoted in r4-r6 carry +-2.5%; six-seed means are 1.01 (main class), 0.96 (penetrating Z=1), 0.95 (phi(>1)).
physics: 仿真器知道每个事件的真相,真仪器不知道。所以这里每一个常数都必须写成「从什么测量得到」:脉冲发生器给增益,无核反应的束流数据给拟合切割,已知厚度的样片给厚度表。
physics_en: A simulator knows the truth of every event and a real instrument does not. So every constant here has to be written as 'obtained from which measurement': a pulser for the gains, beam data without nuclear interactions for the fit cut, samples of known thickness for the thickness table.

pois.label: SEU/SEL 输入表
pois.detail: 右下这块表牌是给计算中心的:硅中 LET 高于某阈值的粒子通量 φ(>L),五行,阈值从 1 到 100 keV/µm,旁边同时写成集成电路界惯用的 MeV·cm²/mg。三种口径并列:望远镜视锥内实测口径、假设各向同性外推到整个下半球、太阳质子事件 ×30 的硬谱与软谱。每一行都是合成场上的设计仿真,没有数据;计算中心的辐射账因此仍登记为「不能闭合」,这张表只说明数据存在之后它会长什么样。
pois.detail_en: The lower-right board is for the compute centre: the flux of particles whose LET in silicon exceeds a threshold, phi(>L), five rows from 1 to 100 keV/um, written alongside in the MeV cm2/mg the chip community uses. Three bases side by side: inside the telescope's cone as measured, extrapolated to the whole downward hemisphere assuming isotropy, and a solar-proton event at thirty times quiet for a hard and a soft spectrum. Every row is a design simulation on a synthetic field, no data; the compute centre's radiation ledger therefore stays 'not closable', and this table only says what its shape will be once data exist.

【r1 2026-09-13】对合成场真值的回收:1 keV/µm 1.06(预注册 0.9–1.1 命中)、100 keV/µm 1.35(预注册 ≥0.8,单侧带命中,实际读高 35%)。读高来自 Z≥20 组的响应:钙按铁的效率算,组别由涨落的中值分配。表注里写明,引 >100 那一行要带这个系统差。

【r1 2026-09-13】预注册写的机制是「关掉三层 ΔE 一致性判别,φ(>100) 回收必须掉到 0.5 以下」。数据说:一致性判别每秒只剔 4e-5 个事件,关掉它什么都不变;把 A·C 符合整个关掉、只看 B 层单击,>100 处读 1.40 对有符合的 1.35,也不掉。原因是读出单元是 300 µm 的整片而不是像素:反冲在整片里的表观 LET 是沉积除以 300 µm,永远到不了 100 keV/µm,所以「单层丢 >100 群体」这个前提(sci-rad-01 单层相机的 0.10)在整片读出里不成立。单层真正多计的是低 LET 端:>1 keV/µm 处单击读 1.22,有符合 1.06,差的是径长。这条预注册机制作废,理由与替换闸(>1 处方向信息的作用 ≥0.10)都记在 json 里。

physics: 单粒子翻转和闩锁看的是一条径迹在灵敏体积里沉积的电荷密度,也就是 LET;所以这张表的自变量是 LET 阈值,不是粒子能量。硅中 keV/µm 除以硅的密度 2.33 g/cm³ 就是器件手册里的 MeV·cm²/mg。
太阳质子事件里来的是 166 MeV 以上的质子,它们在硅里的 LET 不到 1 keV/µm;所以事件期间 >1 keV/µm 那一行涨十几倍,>100 那一行纹丝不动:闩锁风险不随暴风走,翻转风险随。
physics_en: Single-event upset and latch-up depend on the charge density a track deposits in the sensitive volume, which is its LET; so the table's variable is an LET threshold, not a particle energy. keV/um in silicon divided by silicon's density of 2.33 g/cm3 is the MeV cm2/mg of the device datasheets.

A solar-proton event brings protons above 166 MeV, whose LET in silicon is below 1 keV/um; so during an event the >1 keV/um row rises more than tenfold while the >100 row does not move: latch-up risk does not follow the storm, upset risk does.
